system:
Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. A visual source video does not wire its soundtrack. composition_facts.audio declares the actually wired audio relationships. If its attachments are empty, an explicit claim that the original soundtrack is preserved, reused, played or carried over is audio_signal_misuse even if the task prefix omits reuse. Newly generated sound is permitted and a similar sound does not demonstrate copying. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.
Positive replacement obligations: inspect replacement_inheritance and its observed_motion_contexts, not only exclusions. The replacement must inherit the identified source figure's observed motion, position and timing. A global action-governs=request entry authorizes only the actor/action actually requested; changing the car's action does not change the driver's action. Compare the final replacement narrative with the identified figure's motion in context. Standing still is not inheriting an observed crossing action unless the caller explicitly changes that same figure's action. Do not invent timing facts outside the declared coverage.
Finding thresholds: similar sounds are not evidence of copying a recording. Generic newly generated engine ambience, a matching pulse, or an appropriate sound texture is legitimate without an assertion that the source recording is played. For audio_signal_misuse quote an explicit source-signal relationship contradicting the typed copy/property role; never infer copying solely from sonic resemblance. Likewise camera movement after an anchored instant is legitimate. A push-in, pan or other dynamic camera event alone does not demonstrate that the initial or final anchor frame was changed. Report frame_content_changed only when actual narrative asserts incompatible frame content or a crop/removal at that anchored instant. These constraints are mandatory; do not report speculative contradictions.

fragments.music: A soft, sustained low score enters faintly beneath the engine and swells slightly as the car emerges.
fragments.shot:shot-1:description: Deep, near-total darkness fills the scene, with no readable horizon and only a faint wash of ambient light lingering at the far edge. The <Subject:car> is at first little more than a low, dark silhouette facing forward; its hood, windshield, and grille merge into the surrounding black, and only the barest edge of the body catches a weak, cool sheen. The silhouette holds for a beat, then creeps forward slightly, the tires rolling almost soundlessly over a barely visible paved surface. The shape stays swallowed by shadow, but the forward motion becomes unmistakable as the car inches closer without yet resolving into full detail; the <Subject:darkness> around it remains dense and continuous, with no clear boundary between the vehicle and the night.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: Deep darkness with only a faint silhouette of the <Subject:car> visible facing forward.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: A low, dark ambient room tone settles over the scene.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: <Subject:car> creeps forward slightly, its silhouette still swallowed by shadow.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:3: The engine note rises faintly as the car advances, and the tires roll softly over pavement.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:4: The camera holds a static shot.
fragments.shot:shot-2:description: The <Subject:car> continues pulling forward out of the <Subject:darkness>. As it advances, ambient light slides across the hood, windshield, and grille, separating the bodywork from the black behind it. The paint returns as a narrow band of reflected light along the fenders; the windshield catches a soft grey sheen, and the grille becomes a set of distinct dark slats. The front of the vehicle grows increasingly readable while the surrounding <Subject:darkness> recedes toward the edges, leaving the car centered against a deep, uncluttered field of shadow. The motion is steady and deliberate, and by the end of the shot the front of the car is fully legible while the rear remains partly lost in the dark, preserving the sense that the vehicle is still emerging from an enclosing night.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:0: <Subject:car> keeps pulling forward out of the <Subject:darkness>.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:1: The engine note continues to rise as the car advances, and tires roll softly over pavement.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:2: Ambient light slides across the <Subject:car>'s hood, windshield, and grille, progressively separating the body from the black.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:3: The front of the <Subject:car> becomes fully readable against the receding <Subject:darkness>.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:4: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.soundscape: A low, dark ambient room tone; a faint engine idle that builds into a steady note; tires rolling softly over pavement as the car advances.
